newsitem.title: AUSTRIA: Austrian shares flat, Verbund leaves mkt cold.
newsitem.headline: Austrian shares flat, Verbund leaves mkt cold.

text.p: Austrian shares ended a shade lower on Wednesday after first half results from national utility Verbund failed to excite the market.
The blue-chip ATX index closed 0.23 points down at 1,035.60 after a brief rally up to 1,041.99 fizzled out. Six shares were up, 13 down and two unchanged.
"There was not enough turnover to sustain the rally, there was not enough momentum," said a trader who saw the ATX index tethered in a 1,020-1,040 points range.
Others were more bullish and sensed demand below 1,030 points.
Verbund, which reported a big rise in first half net profit but a 20 percent drop in its operating result, topped turnover with 21,720 lots traded. Verbund shares closed 5.8 schillings down at 758.7.
The day's biggest decliner was building materials group Wienerberger, which fell 1.53 percent to 1,935 schillings on relatively low volume.
In contrast, traders said large buy orders boosted steel firm VA Stahl and oil and chemicals OMV. VA Stahl was the top gainer, climbing 2.66 percent to 347 schillings on 20,520 lots.
The all-share Vienna bourse index edged 0.24 points higher to 404.87. September ATX futures stood 1.2 points down at 1,036.8.
